295 static int32_t MmwDemo_RFParser_setAoAParamsTDM
296 (
297  MmwDemo_RFParserOutParams *outParams,
298  bool *pFoundValidProfile,
299  int16_t frameTotalChirps,
300  uint16_t *validChirpTxEnBits,
301  bool bpmEnabled
302 )
303 {
304 
305  uint32_t chirpLoopIdx;
306  bool validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp = false;
307  uint16_t validProfileTxEn = 0;
308  int32_t retVal = 0;
309  bool validProfileHasElevation = false;
310  int32_t i;
311 
312 
313  /* now loop through unique chirps and check if we found all of the ones
314  needed for the frame and then determine the azimuth/elevation antenna
315  configuration
316  */
317  if (*pFoundValidProfile==true) {
318  int16_t nonElevFirstChirpIdx = -1;
319  for (chirpLoopIdx = 0; chirpLoopIdx < frameTotalChirps; chirpLoopIdx++)
320  {
321  bool validChirpHasElevation = false;
322  bool validChirpHasOneTxPerChirp = false;
323  uint16_t chirpTxEn = validChirpTxEnBits[chirpLoopIdx];
324  if (chirpTxEn == 0) {
325  /* this profile doesn't have all the needed chirps */
326  *pFoundValidProfile = false;
327  break;
328  }
329 
330  /* check if this is an elevation TX chirp - if yes, it is assumed to be 4Rx, 3Tx case */
331  validChirpHasElevation = (chirpTxEn == MmwDemo_RFParserHwCfg.elevTxAntMask);
332  validProfileHasElevation |= validChirpHasElevation;
333 
334  /* if not, then check the MIMO config */
335  if (!validChirpHasElevation)
336  {
337  uint8_t log2TxEn;
338 
339  if(bpmEnabled)
340  { /* In case of BPM, check if both TX antennas are enabled*/
341  if(chirpTxEn != MmwDemo_RFParserHwCfg.azimTxAntMask)
342  {
343  /* The frame is configured as BPM but this chirp does not enable both TX antennas*/
344  *pFoundValidProfile = false;
345 #ifdef MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_DBG
346  printf("Bad BPM configuration. chirpTxEn=%d for chirp %d \n",chirpTxEn,chirpLoopIdx);
347 #endif
348  break;
349  }
350  }
351  else
352  {
353  /* If only TX antenna is enabled, then its 0x1<< log2TxEn should equal chirpTxEn */
354  log2TxEn = mathUtils_floorLog2(chirpTxEn);
355  validChirpHasOneTxPerChirp = (chirpTxEn == (1 << log2TxEn));
356  }
357 
358  /* if this is the first chirp without elevation, record the chirp's
359  MIMO config as profile's MIMO config. We dont handle intermix
360  at this point */
361  if (nonElevFirstChirpIdx == -1) {
362  validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp = validChirpHasOneTxPerChirp;
363  nonElevFirstChirpIdx = chirpLoopIdx;
364  }
365 
366  /* if this is the first chirp, record the chirp's
367  MIMO config as profile's MIMO config. We dont handle intermix
368  at this point */
369  if (chirpLoopIdx == 0)
370  {
371  validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp = validChirpHasOneTxPerChirp;
372  }
373  /* check the chirp's MIMO config against Profile's MIMO config */
374  if (validChirpHasOneTxPerChirp != validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp)
375  {
376  /* this profile doesnt have all chirps with same MIMO config */
377  *pFoundValidProfile = false;
378  break;
379  }
380  }
381 
382  /* save the antennas actually enabled in this profile */
383  validProfileTxEn |= chirpTxEn;
384  }
385  }
386 
387  /* found valid chirps for the frame; mark this profile valid */
388  if (*pFoundValidProfile == true) {
389  uint32_t numTxAntAzim = 0;
390  uint32_t numTxAntElev = 0;
391 
392  outParams->numTxAntennas = 0;
393  if (validProfileHasElevation)
394  {
395  numTxAntElev = 1;
396  }
397 
398  if (bpmEnabled == true)
399  {
400  /* BPM eanbled */
401  numTxAntAzim = 2;
402  }
403  else if (validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp == true)
404  {
405  uint8_t log2TxEn;
406 
407  while(validProfileTxEn)
408  {
409  log2TxEn = mathUtils_floorLog2(validProfileTxEn);
410  if ((0x1 << log2TxEn) & MmwDemo_RFParserHwCfg.azimTxAntMask)
411  {
412  numTxAntAzim++;
413  }
414  validProfileTxEn &= ~(0x1<< log2TxEn);
415  }
416  }
417  else /* i.e. SIMO case, all chirps have same one Tx antenna. */
418  {
419  /* in this case, for AOA, Tx Azimuth antenna is only 1. */
420  if ((validProfileTxEn & MmwDemo_RFParserHwCfg.azimTxAntMask) != 0)
421  {
422  numTxAntAzim = 1;
423  }
424  else
425  {
426  numTxAntAzim = 0;
427  }
428  }
429 
430 #ifdef MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_DBG
431  printf("Azimuth Tx: %d (MIMO:%d), Elev Tx:%d\n",
432  numTxAntAzim,validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp,numTxAntElev);
433 #endif
434 
435  outParams->numTxAntennas = numTxAntAzim + numTxAntElev;
436  if (outParams->numTxAntennas > SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS)
437  {
438  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS;
439  goto exit;
440  }
441 
442  outParams->numVirtualAntAzim = numTxAntAzim * outParams->numRxAntennas;
443  outParams->numVirtualAntElev = numTxAntElev * outParams->numRxAntennas;
444  outParams->numVirtualAntennas = outParams->numVirtualAntAzim +
445  outParams->numVirtualAntElev;
446 
447  /* Sanity Check: Ensure that the number of antennas is within system limits */
448  if ((outParams->numVirtualAntennas <= 0) ||
449  (outParams->numVirtualAntennas > (SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS * SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL)))
450  {
451  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__NUM_VIRTUAL_ANTENNAS;
452  }
453 
454  /* txAntOrder[] will be needed for Rx Channel Phase Measurement/Compensation routines */
455  if (validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp)
456  {
457  for (i = 0; i < outParams->numTxAntennas; i++)
458  {
459  outParams->txAntOrder[i] = mathUtils_floorLog2(validChirpTxEnBits[i]);
460  }
461  }
462  else
463  {
464  for (i = 0; i < outParams->numTxAntennas; i++)
465  {
466  outParams->txAntOrder[i] = i;
467  }
468  }
469 
470  outParams->validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp = validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp;
471 
472 #ifdef MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_DBG
473  printf("Ant setting virtualAzim: %d , virtual Elev :%d\n",
474  outParams->numVirtualAntAzim, outParams->numVirtualAntElev);
475 #endif
476  }
477 
478 exit:
479  return (retVal);
480 }

680 static int32_t MmwDemo_RFParser_parseCtrlConfigTDM
681 (
682  MmwDemo_RFParserOutParams *outParams,
683  uint8_t subFrameIdx,
684  MMWave_OpenCfg *openCfg,
685  MMWave_CtrlCfg *ctrlCfg,
686  float rfFreqScaleFactor,
687  bool bpmEnabled
688 )
689 {
690  uint16_t frameChirpStartIdx;
691  uint16_t frameChirpEndIdx;
692  int16_t frameTotalChirps;
693  uint32_t profileLoopIdx, chirpLoopIdx;
694  bool foundValidProfile = false;
695  uint16_t channelTxEn = openCfg->chCfg.txChannelEn;
696  uint16_t channelRxEn = openCfg->chCfg.rxChannelEn;
697  uint8_t channel;
698  uint8_t numRxAntennas;
699  uint16_t numLoops;
700  int32_t retVal = 0;
701  int32_t errCode;
702  float bandwidth, centerFreq, adcStart, slope, startFreq, idleTime;
703 
704  /***********************************************
705  * Sanity Check on ADC configuration
706  ***********************************************/
707  /* Only support 16 Bits ADC out bits */
708  if(openCfg->adcOutCfg.fmt.b2AdcBits != 2U)
709  {
710  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NON_16BITS_ADC;
711  goto exit;
712  }
713 
714  /* Only support Real */
715  if (openCfg->adcOutCfg.fmt.b2AdcOutFmt != 0U)
716  {
717  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__ADC_FORMAT;
718  goto exit;
719  }
720 
721  if(openCfg->adcOutCfg.fmt.b2AdcOutFmt == 0){
722  outParams->adcDataFmtIsReal = 1; /* Data format is real */
723  }
724  else{
725  outParams->adcDataFmtIsReal = 0; /* Data format is complex */
726  }
727 
728  /***********************************************
729  * Parse openCfg
730  ***********************************************/
731  /* Find number of enabled channels */
732  numRxAntennas = 0U;
733  for (channel = 0U; channel < SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL; channel++)
734  {
735  if(channelRxEn & (0x1U << channel))
736  {
737  outParams->rxAntOrder[numRxAntennas] = channel;
738  /* Track the number of receive channels: */
739  numRxAntennas++;
740  }
741  else
742  {
743  outParams->rxAntOrder[channel] = 0U;
744  }
745  }
746  outParams->numRxAntennas = numRxAntennas;
747 
748  /***********************************************
749  * Parse frameCfg in legacy chirp mode
750  ***********************************************/
751  if((ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_FRAME)||
752  (ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_FRAME) )
753  {
754  /* Read frameCfg chirp start/stop index */
755  frameChirpStartIdx = MmwDemo_RFParser_getChirpStartIdx(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
756  frameChirpEndIdx = MmwDemo_RFParser_getChirpEndIdx(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
757  numLoops = MmwDemo_RFParser_getNumLoops(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
758  outParams->framePeriod = MmwDemo_RFParser_getFramePeriod_ms(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
759  frameTotalChirps = frameChirpEndIdx - frameChirpStartIdx + 1;
760 
761  if (ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_FRAME)
762  {
763  if(ctrlCfg->u.advancedFrameCfg[0].frameCfg.frameSeq.subFrameCfg[subFrameIdx].numOfBurst != 1)
764  {
765  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NON_ONE_NUMOFBURST_FOR_ADVANCED_FRAME;
766  goto exit;
767  }
768  }
769 
770  /* since validChirpTxEnBits is static array of 32 */
771  if(frameTotalChirps > 32U)
772  {
773  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOIMPL__NUM_UNIQUE_CHIRPS_MORE_THAN_32;
774  }
775 
776  /* loop for profiles and find if it has valid chirps */
777  /* we support only one profile in this processing chain */
778  for (profileLoopIdx = 0;
779  ((profileLoopIdx < MMWAVE_MAX_PROFILE) && (foundValidProfile == false));
780  profileLoopIdx++)
781  {
782  uint32_t mmWaveNumChirps = 0;
783  uint16_t validChirpTxEnBits[32]={0};
784  MMWave_ProfileHandle profileHandle;
785 
786  profileHandle = MmwDemo_RFParser_getProfileHandle(ctrlCfg, profileLoopIdx);
787  if (profileHandle == NULL)
788  continue; /* skip this profile */
789 
790  /* get numChirps for this profile; skip error checking */
791  retVal = MMWave_getNumChirps(profileHandle, &mmWaveNumChirps, &errCode);
792  if (retVal != 0)
793  {
794  retVal = errCode;
795  goto exit;
796  }
797 
798  /* loop for chirps and find if it has valid chirps for the frame
799  looping around for all chirps in a profile, in case
800  there are duplicate chirps
801  */
802  for (chirpLoopIdx = 1; chirpLoopIdx <= mmWaveNumChirps; chirpLoopIdx++)
803  {
804  MMWave_ChirpHandle chirpHandle;
805  retVal = MMWave_getChirpHandle(profileHandle, chirpLoopIdx, &chirpHandle, &errCode);
806  if (retVal != 0)
807  {
808  retVal = errCode;
809  goto exit;
810  }
811  /* get handle and read ChirpCfg */
812  {
813  rlChirpCfg_t chirpCfg;
814  retVal = MMWave_getChirpCfg(chirpHandle, &chirpCfg, &errCode);
815  if (retVal != 0)
816  {
817  retVal = errCode;
818  goto exit;
819  }
820  {
821  uint16_t chirpTxEn = chirpCfg.txEnable;
822  /* do chirps fall in range and has valid antenna enabled */
823  if ((chirpCfg.chirpStartIdx >= frameChirpStartIdx) &&
824  (chirpCfg.chirpEndIdx <= frameChirpEndIdx) &&
825  ((chirpTxEn & channelTxEn) > 0))
826  {
827  uint16_t idx = 0;
828  for (idx = (chirpCfg.chirpStartIdx - frameChirpStartIdx);
829  idx <= (chirpCfg.chirpEndIdx - frameChirpStartIdx); idx++)
830  {
831  validChirpTxEnBits[idx] = chirpTxEn;
832  foundValidProfile = true;
833  }
834  }
835  }
836  }
837  }
838 
839  /* now parse through all valid chirps, check if the profile is valid and then set the AoA related parameters */
840  retVal = MmwDemo_RFParser_setAoAParamsTDM(outParams,
841  &foundValidProfile,
842  frameTotalChirps,
843  validChirpTxEnBits,
844  bpmEnabled);
845  if (retVal != 0)
846  {
847  goto exit;
848  }
849 
850  /* found valid chirps for the frame; set remaining parameters */
851  if (foundValidProfile == true) {
852  rlProfileCfg_t profileCfg;
853  outParams->validProfileIdx = profileLoopIdx;
854  /* Get the profile configuration: */
855  retVal = MMWave_getProfileCfg(profileHandle,&profileCfg, &errCode);
856  if (retVal != 0)
857  {
858  retVal = errCode;
859  goto exit;
860  }
861 
862 #ifndef MMW_ENABLE_NEGATIVE_FREQ_SLOPE
863  /* Check frequency slope */
864  if (profileCfg.freqSlopeConst < 0)
865  {
866  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NEGATIVE_FREQ_SLOPE;
867  goto exit;
868  }
869 #endif
870  /* set other parameters */
871  outParams->numAdcSamples = profileCfg.numAdcSamples;
872 
873  /* If input data is real, then only half the samples of the calcuated FFT (of
874  order mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples)) will be valid due to
875  symmetry. In that case, the number of effective range bins would be
876  mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples); */
877  if (outParams->adcDataFmtIsReal){
878  outParams->numRangeBins = mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples)/2;
879  }
880  else{
881  outParams->numRangeBins = mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples);
882  }
883 
884  outParams->numChirpsPerFrame = frameTotalChirps * numLoops;
885 
886  outParams->numDopplerChirps = outParams->numChirpsPerFrame/outParams->numTxAntennas;
887  outParams->numDopplerBins = mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numDopplerChirps);
888 
889  adcStart = ((float)profileCfg.adcStartTimeConst * 10.f * 1.e-9);
890  startFreq = (float)profileCfg.startFreqConst/(float)(1U << 26)*rfFreqScaleFactor*(float)1e9;
891  slope = (float)profileCfg.freqSlopeConst * ((rfFreqScaleFactor*1e3*900.f)/(float)(1U << 26)) * 1e12;
892  bandwidth = (slope * outParams->numAdcSamples)/(profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3);
893  centerFreq = startFreq + bandwidth * 0.5f + adcStart * slope;
894  outParams->chirpInterval = (float)(profileCfg.idleTimeConst + profileCfg.rampEndTime)/1000.*10*1.e-6;
895 
896  outParams->rangeStep = (MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC * profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3) /
897  (2.f * slope * mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples));
898  outParams->rangeResolution = (MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC * profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3) /
899  (2.f * slope * outParams->numAdcSamples);
900  outParams->dopplerStep = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC /
901  (2.f * outParams->numDopplerBins * outParams->numTxAntennas *
902  centerFreq * outParams->chirpInterval);
903  outParams->dopplerResolution = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC /
904  (2.f * outParams->numChirpsPerFrame * centerFreq * outParams->chirpInterval);
905 
906 #ifdef MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_DBG
907  printf("Ant setting virtualAzim: %d , virtual Elev :%d\n",
908  outParams->numVirtualAntAzim, outParams->numVirtualAntElev);
909  printf("startFreqConst: %d\n", profileCfg.startFreqConst);
910  printf("rfFreqScaleFactor: %f\n", rfFreqScaleFactor);
911  printf("bandwidth : %f GHz\n", bandwidth*1.e-9);
912  printf("adcStartTimeConst: %d\n", profileCfg.adcStartTimeConst);
913  printf("freqSlopeConst: %d\n", profileCfg.freqSlopeConst);
914  printf("centerFreq: %f GHz\n", centerFreq*1.e-9);
915  printf("dopplerStep: %f\n", outParams->dopplerStep);
916  printf("adcStart: %f us\n", adcStart * 1e6);
917  printf("slope: %f GHz\n", slope*1.e-9);
918  printf("startFreq: %f GHz\n", startFreq*1.e-9);
919  printf("numRangeBins: %d\n", outParams->numRangeBins);
920  printf("rangeStep: %f\n", outParams->rangeStep);
921  printf("rangeResolution: %f\n", outParams->rangeResolution);
922 #endif
923  }/* end of foundValidProfile condition */
924  }/* end of profile loop */
925 
926  if (foundValidProfile == false)
927  {
928  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__VALID_PROFILECFG_NOT_FOUND;
929  goto exit;
930  }
931  }/* end of dfeDataOutputMode if condition*/
932 
933  else if((ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_CHIRP_LEGACY_FRAME)||
934  (ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_CHIRP_ADVANCED_FRAME))
935  {
936  /* In advance chirp mode, numLoops is the total number of chirps in a frame. */
937  numLoops = MmwDemo_RFParser_getNumLoops(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
938  outParams->framePeriod = MmwDemo_RFParser_getFramePeriod_ms(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
939 
940  if (ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_CHIRP_ADVANCED_FRAME)
941  {
942  if(ctrlCfg->u.advancedFrameCfg[0].frameCfg.frameSeq.subFrameCfg[subFrameIdx].numOfBurst != 1)
943  {
944  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NON_ONE_NUMOFBURST_FOR_ADVANCED_FRAME;
945  goto exit;
946  }
947  }
948 
949  uint8_t advChirpParamIdx =0;
950  MMWave_AdvChirpHandle advChirpHandle;
951  rlAdvChirpCfg_t advChirpCfg;
952  rlUInt16_t patternIdx=0, lutResetPeriod=0;
953  rlInt32_t* lutDataPtr;
954  rlInt32_t lutData = 0;
955  MMWave_ProfileHandle profileHandle;
956  rlProfileCfg_t profileCfg;
957  rlUInt16_t deltaResetPeriod=0;
958  rlInt32_t deltaDither =0;
959  float deltaDitherAvg=0, LUTDataAvg=0;
960 
961  for(advChirpParamIdx =0; advChirpParamIdx< MMWAVE_ADVANCE_CHIRP_NUM_PARAMS; advChirpParamIdx++)
962  {
963  /* Get the Advanced Chirp Handle associated at the specified param index */
964  if(MMWave_getAdvChirpHandle((MMWave_Handle)gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle, advChirpParamIdx, &advChirpHandle, &errCode)<0)
965  {
966  /* Error: Unable to get the chirp handle */
967  retVal = errCode;
968  goto exit;
969  }
970 
971  /* get the advance chirp configs */
972  retVal = MMWave_getAdvChirpParams(advChirpHandle, &advChirpCfg, &errCode);
973  if(retVal!=0)
974  {
975  retVal = errCode;
976  goto exit;
977  }
978 
979  /* get the LUT data ptr */
980  retVal = MMWave_getLUTData(advChirpHandle, &lutDataPtr, &errCode);
981  lutDataPtr = lutDataPtr + advChirpCfg.lutSfIndexOffset*subFrameIdx;
982  if((retVal!=0)||(lutDataPtr==NULL))
983  {
984  retVal = errCode;
985  goto exit;
986  }
987 
988  if(advChirpCfg.deltaResetPeriod == 0)
989  deltaResetPeriod = numLoops; /* reset as per global reset mode, i.e after burst/subframe/frame*/
990  else if(advChirpCfg.deltaResetPeriod == 1)
991  deltaResetPeriod = 0; /* delta increment is diabled */
992  else
993  deltaResetPeriod = advChirpCfg.deltaResetPeriod; /* reset after every deltaResetPeriod (M) chirps */
994 
995  /* similar to deltaResetPeriod; */
996  if(advChirpCfg.lutResetPeriod == 0)
997  lutResetPeriod = numLoops;
998  else if(advChirpCfg.lutResetPeriod == 1)
999  lutResetPeriod = 0;
1000  else
1001  lutResetPeriod = advChirpCfg.lutResetPeriod;
1002 
1003  switch(subFrameIdx)
1004  {
1005  case 0:
1006  {
1007  deltaDither = advChirpCfg.sf0ChirpParamDelta;
1008  break;
1009  }
1010  case 1:
1011  {
1012  deltaDither = advChirpCfg.sf1ChirpParamDelta;
1013  break;
1014  }
1015  case 2:
1016  {
1017  deltaDither = advChirpCfg.sf2ChirpParamDelta;
1018  break;
1019  }
1020  case 3:
1021  {
1022  deltaDither = advChirpCfg.sf3ChirpParamDelta;
1023  break;
1024  }
1025  default:
1026  {
1027  /* invalid subframe number*/
1028  retVal=-1;
1029  goto exit;
1030  }
1031  }
1032 
1033  switch(advChirpParamIdx)
1034  {
1035  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_PROFILE_VAR:
1036  {
1037  /* we support only one profile per subframe in this processing chain */
1038  /* get the configured profile: assuming the first configured profile is valid for all the chirps in a frame */
1039  lutData = *(lutDataPtr);
1040 
1041  /* check if the configured profile is defined or not */
1042  profileHandle = MmwDemo_RFParser_getProfileHandle(ctrlCfg, lutData);
1043  if (profileHandle == NULL)
1044  {
1045  foundValidProfile = false;
1046  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__VALID_PROFILECFG_NOT_FOUND; /*profile not defined*/
1047  goto exit;
1048  }
1049 
1050  retVal = MMWave_getProfileCfg(profileHandle, &profileCfg, &errCode);
1051  if (retVal != 0)
1052  {
1053  foundValidProfile = false;
1054  retVal = errCode;
1055  goto exit;
1056  }
1057  foundValidProfile = true;
1058  break;
1059  }
1060  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_FREQ_START_VAR:
1061  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_FREQ_SLOPE_VAR:
1062  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_IDLE_TIME_VAR:
1063  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_ADC_START_TIME_VAR:
1064  {
1065  /* average of dithers when delta dither is enabled*/
1066  deltaDitherAvg =0;
1067  /* delta dither is enabled when deltaParamUpdatePeriod!=0 and deltaResetPeriod!=0*/
1068  if(advChirpCfg.deltaParamUpdatePeriod !=0)
1069  {
1070  /* average of sum of Arithmetic Progression series */
1071  /* Sum = n/2[a0+a_n] = (n-1)/2[0+\delta*1+\delta*(n-1)] = (n-1)/2[\delta*n] */
1072  /* Avg = \delta * (n-1) /2 ; n= #numUpdates*/
1073  /* Assuming deltaResetPeriod is integer multiple of deltaParamUpdatePeriod; as it should be*/
1074  deltaDitherAvg = (float)(deltaDither * (float)(deltaResetPeriod/advChirpCfg.deltaParamUpdatePeriod -1)) /2.f;
1075  }
1076 
1077  /* average of lut dithers when lut dither is enabled */
1078  if ((advChirpCfg.lutParamUpdatePeriod !=0) && (lutResetPeriod!=0))
1079  {
1080  for (patternIdx =0; patternIdx< lutResetPeriod/advChirpCfg.lutParamUpdatePeriod; patternIdx++)
1081  {
1082  LUTDataAvg += *(lutDataPtr + patternIdx);
1083  }
1084  LUTDataAvg = (float)LUTDataAvg/patternIdx;
1085  }
1086  else
1087  {
1088  /* first lut value is used */
1089  LUTDataAvg = *lutDataPtr;
1090  }
1091 
1092  switch(advChirpParamIdx)
1093  {
1094  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_FREQ_START_VAR:
1095  {
1096  /* Average start frequency for a frame */
1097  startFreq = (float)profileCfg.startFreqConst/(float)(1U << 26)*rfFreqScaleFactor*(float)1e9 +
1098  (float)deltaDitherAvg/(float)(1U << 26)*rfFreqScaleFactor*(float)1e9 +
1099  (float)LUTDataAvg/(float)(1U << 26)*rfFreqScaleFactor*(float)1e9*(float)(1U<<advChirpCfg.lutChirpParamScale);
1100  break;
1101  }
1102  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_FREQ_SLOPE_VAR:
1103  {
1104  /* Average frequency slope for a frame */
1105  slope = (float)profileCfg.freqSlopeConst*((rfFreqScaleFactor*1e3*900.f)/(float)(1U << 26)) * 1e12 +
1106  (float)deltaDitherAvg*((rfFreqScaleFactor*1e3*900.f)/(float)(1U << 26)) * 1e12 +
1107  (float)LUTDataAvg*((rfFreqScaleFactor*1e3*900.f)/(float)(1U << 26)) * 1e12;
1108  break;
1109  }
1110  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_IDLE_TIME_VAR:
1111  {
1112  /* Average idle time for a frame */
1113  idleTime = (float)profileCfg.idleTimeConst*10*1.e-9 +
1114  (float)deltaDitherAvg*10*1.e-9 +
1115  (float)LUTDataAvg*10*1.e-9*(1U << advChirpCfg.lutChirpParamScale);
1116  break;
1117  }
1118  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_ADC_START_TIME_VAR:
1119  {
1120  /* Average adc start time for a frame */
1121  adcStart = (float)profileCfg.adcStartTimeConst*10*1.e-9 +
1122  (float)deltaDitherAvg*10*1.e-9 +
1123  (float)LUTDataAvg*10*1.e-9*(1U << advChirpCfg.lutChirpParamScale);
1124  break;
1125  }
1126  }
1127  break;
1128  }
1129  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_TX_EN_VAR:
1130  {
1131  int32_t chirpTxEn;
1132  uint16_t validChirpTxEnBits[MMWAVE_EACH_CHIRP_PARAM_MAX_LUT_BUF_SIZE]={0};
1133  /* check for all the chirps in a frame/subframe, if valid TX antenna is enabled */
1134  if ((advChirpCfg.lutParamUpdatePeriod != 0 ) && (lutResetPeriod!=0))
1135  {
1136  /* more than 1 pattern of TX antenna is configured in LUT: traverse and check if valid TX antennas is enabled*/
1137  for (patternIdx =0; patternIdx< lutResetPeriod/advChirpCfg.lutParamUpdatePeriod; patternIdx++)
1138  {
1139  chirpTxEn = *(lutDataPtr+patternIdx);
1140  if((chirpTxEn != 0)&&((chirpTxEn & channelTxEn) > 0))
1141  {
1142  validChirpTxEnBits[patternIdx] = (uint16_t)chirpTxEn;
1143  }
1144  else
1145  {
1146  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__INVALID_TX_ANTENNA_ENABLED;
1147  goto exit;
1148  }
1149  }
1150  }
1151  else
1152  {
1153  /* first lut value is used */
1154  chirpTxEn = *(lutDataPtr);
1155  validChirpTxEnBits[0] = (uint16_t)chirpTxEn;
1156  patternIdx =1;
1157  }
1158  /* now parse through all valid chirps, check if the profile is valid and then set the AoA related parameters */
1159  retVal = MmwDemo_RFParser_setAoAParamsTDM(outParams,
1160  &foundValidProfile,
1161  patternIdx,
1162  validChirpTxEnBits,
1163  bpmEnabled);
1164  break;
1165  }
1166  }/* end of switch case */
1167  }/* end of advance chirp params for loop */
1168 
1169  /* found valid chirps for the frame; set remaining parameters */
1170  if (foundValidProfile == true)
1171  {
1172 #ifndef MMW_ENABLE_NEGATIVE_FREQ_SLOPE
1173  /* Check frequency slope */
1174  if (profileCfg.freqSlopeConst < 0)
1175  {
1176  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NEGATIVE_FREQ_SLOPE;
1177  goto exit;
1178  }
1179 #endif
1180  /* set other parameters */
1181  outParams->numAdcSamples = profileCfg.numAdcSamples;
1182 
1183  /* If input data is real, then only half the samples of the calcuated FFT (of
1184  order mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples)) will be valid due to
1185  symmetry. In that case, the number of effective range bins would be
1186  mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples); */
1187  if (outParams->adcDataFmtIsReal){
1188  outParams->numRangeBins = mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples)/2;
1189  }
1190  else{
1191  outParams->numRangeBins = mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples);
1192  }
1193 
1194  outParams->numChirpsPerFrame = numLoops;
1195 
1196  outParams->numDopplerChirps = outParams->numChirpsPerFrame/outParams->numTxAntennas;
1197  outParams->numDopplerBins = mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numDopplerChirps);
1198 
1199  bandwidth = (slope * outParams->numAdcSamples)/(profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3);
1200  centerFreq = startFreq + bandwidth * 0.5f + adcStart * slope;
1201  outParams->chirpInterval = (float)idleTime + (float)((float)profileCfg.rampEndTime/1000.*10*1.e-6);
1202 
1203  outParams->rangeStep = (MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC * profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3) /
1204  (2.f * slope * mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples));
1205  outParams->rangeResolution = (MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC * profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3) /
1206  (2.f * slope * outParams->numAdcSamples);
1207 
1208  outParams->dopplerStep = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC /
1209  (2.f * outParams->numDopplerBins * outParams->numTxAntennas *
1210  centerFreq * outParams->chirpInterval);
1211  outParams->dopplerResolution = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC /
1212  (2.f * outParams->numChirpsPerFrame * centerFreq * outParams->chirpInterval);
1213 
1214 #ifdef MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_DBG
1215  printf("Ant setting virtualAzim: %d , virtual Elev :%d\n",
1216  outParams->numVirtualAntAzim, outParams->numVirtualAntElev);
1217  printf("startFreqConst: %d\n", profileCfg.startFreqConst);
1218  printf("rfFreqScaleFactor: %f\n", rfFreqScaleFactor);
1219  printf("bandwidth : %f GHz\n", bandwidth*1.e-9);
1220  printf("adcStartTimeConst: %d\n", profileCfg.adcStartTimeConst);
1221  printf("freqSlopeConst: %d\n", profileCfg.freqSlopeConst);
1222  printf("centerFreq: %f GHz\n", centerFreq*1.e-9);
1223  printf("dopplerStep: %f\n", outParams->dopplerStep);
1224  printf("adcStart: %f us\n", adcStart * 1e6);
1225  printf("idleTime: %f us\n", idleTime * 1e6);
1226  printf("slope: %f GHz\n", slope*1.e-9);
1227  printf("startFreq: %f GHz\n", startFreq*1.e-9);
1228  printf("numRangeBins: %d\n", outParams->numRangeBins);
1229  printf("rangeStep: %f\n", outParams->rangeStep);
1230  printf("rangeResolution: %f\n", outParams->rangeResolution);
1231 #endif
1232 
1233  }/* end of foundValidProfile condition */
1234 
1235  else
1236  {
1237  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__VALID_PROFILECFG_NOT_FOUND;
1238  goto exit;
1239  }
1240 
1241  }/* end of dfeDataOutputMode else condition*/
1242 exit:
1243  return (retVal);
1244 }

1265 static int32_t MmwDemo_RFParser_parseCtrlConfigDDM
1266 (
1267  MmwDemo_RFParserOutParams *outParams,
1268  uint8_t subFrameIdx,
1269  MMWave_OpenCfg *openCfg,
1270  MMWave_CtrlCfg *ctrlCfg,
1271  float rfFreqScaleFactor,
1272  bool bpmEnabled
1273 )
1274 {
1275  uint16_t frameChirpStartIdx;
1276  uint16_t frameChirpEndIdx;
1277  int16_t frameTotalChirps;
1278  uint32_t profileLoopIdx, chirpLoopIdx;
1279  bool foundValidProfile = false;
1280  uint16_t channelTxEn = openCfg->chCfg.txChannelEn;
1281  uint8_t channel;
1282  uint8_t numRxAntennas;
1283  uint16_t numLoops;
1284  int32_t retVal = 0;
1285  int32_t errCode;
1286  float bandwidth, centerFreq, adcStart, slope, startFreq, idleTime;
1287 
1288  /***********************************************
1289  * Sanity Check on ADC configuration
1290  ***********************************************/
1291  /* Only support 16 Bits ADC out bits */
1292  if(openCfg->adcOutCfg.fmt.b2AdcBits != 2U)
1293  {
1294  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NON_16BITS_ADC;
1295  goto exit;
1296  }
1297 
1298  /* Only support Real */
1299  if (openCfg->adcOutCfg.fmt.b2AdcOutFmt != 0U)
1300  {
1301  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__ADC_FORMAT;
1302  goto exit;
1303  }
1304 
1305  if(openCfg->adcOutCfg.fmt.b2AdcOutFmt == 0){
1306  outParams->adcDataFmtIsReal = 1; /* Data format is real */
1307  }
1308  else{
1309  outParams->adcDataFmtIsReal = 0; /* Data format is complex */
1310  }
1311 
1312  /***********************************************
1313  * Parse openCfg
1314  ***********************************************/
1315  /* Find number of enabled channels */
1316  numRxAntennas = 0U;
1317  for (channel = 0U; channel < SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL; channel++)
1318  {
1319  if(openCfg->chCfg.rxChannelEn & (0x1U << channel))
1320  {
1321  outParams->rxAntOrder[numRxAntennas] = channel;
1322  /* Track the number of receive channels: */
1323  numRxAntennas++;
1324  }
1325  else
1326  {
1327  outParams->rxAntOrder[channel] = 0U;
1328  }
1329  }
1330  outParams->numRxAntennas = numRxAntennas;
1331 
1332  /***********************************************
1333  * Parse frameCfg in legacy chirp mode
1334  ***********************************************/
1335  if((ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_FRAME)||
1336  (ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_FRAME) )
1337  {
1338  /* Read frameCfg chirp start/stop index */
1339  frameChirpStartIdx = MmwDemo_RFParser_getChirpStartIdx(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
1340  frameChirpEndIdx = MmwDemo_RFParser_getChirpEndIdx(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
1341  numLoops = MmwDemo_RFParser_getNumLoops(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
1342  outParams->framePeriod = MmwDemo_RFParser_getFramePeriod_ms(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
1343  frameTotalChirps = frameChirpEndIdx - frameChirpStartIdx + 1;
1344 
1345  if (ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_FRAME)
1346  {
1347  if(ctrlCfg->u.advancedFrameCfg[0].frameCfg.frameSeq.subFrameCfg[subFrameIdx].numOfBurst != 1)
1348  {
1349  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NON_ONE_NUMOFBURST_FOR_ADVANCED_FRAME;
1350  goto exit;
1351  }
1352  }
1353 
1354  /* loop for profiles and find if it has valid chirps */
1355  /* we support only one profile in this processing chain */
1356  for (profileLoopIdx = 0;
1357  ((profileLoopIdx < MMWAVE_MAX_PROFILE) && (foundValidProfile == false));
1358  profileLoopIdx++)
1359  {
1360  uint32_t mmWaveNumChirps = 0;
1361  uint16_t validChirpTxEnBits[192]={0};
1362  MMWave_ProfileHandle profileHandle;
1363 
1364  profileHandle = MmwDemo_RFParser_getProfileHandle(ctrlCfg, profileLoopIdx);
1365  if (profileHandle == NULL)
1366  continue; /* skip this profile */
1367 
1368  /* get numChirps for this profile; skip error checking */
1369  retVal = MMWave_getNumChirps(profileHandle, &mmWaveNumChirps, &errCode);
1370  if (retVal != 0)
1371  {
1372  retVal = errCode;
1373  goto exit;
1374  }
1375 
1376  /* loop for chirps and find if it has valid chirps for the frame
1377  looping around for all chirps in a profile, in case
1378  there are duplicate chirps
1379  */
1380  for (chirpLoopIdx = 1; chirpLoopIdx <= mmWaveNumChirps; chirpLoopIdx++)
1381  {
1382  MMWave_ChirpHandle chirpHandle;
1383  retVal = MMWave_getChirpHandle(profileHandle, chirpLoopIdx, &chirpHandle, &errCode);
1384  if (retVal != 0)
1385  {
1386  retVal = errCode;
1387  goto exit;
1388  }
1389  /* get handle and read ChirpCfg */
1390  {
1391  rlChirpCfg_t chirpCfg;
1392  retVal = MMWave_getChirpCfg(chirpHandle, &chirpCfg, &errCode);
1393  if (retVal != 0)
1394  {
1395  retVal = errCode;
1396  goto exit;
1397  }
1398  {
1399  uint16_t chirpTxEn = chirpCfg.txEnable;
1400  /* do chirps fall in range and has valid antenna enabled */
1401  if ((chirpCfg.chirpStartIdx >= frameChirpStartIdx) &&
1402  (chirpCfg.chirpEndIdx <= frameChirpEndIdx) &&
1403  ((chirpTxEn & channelTxEn) > 0))
1404  {
1405  uint16_t idx = 0;
1406  for (idx = (chirpCfg.chirpStartIdx - frameChirpStartIdx);
1407  idx <= (chirpCfg.chirpEndIdx - frameChirpStartIdx); idx++)
1408  {
1409  validChirpTxEnBits[idx] = chirpTxEn;
1410  foundValidProfile = true;
1411  }
1412  }
1413  }
1414  }
1415  }
1416 
1417  /* now parse through all valid chirps, check if the profile is valid and then set the AoA related parameters */
1418  retVal = MmwDemo_RFParser_setAoAParamsDDM(outParams,
1419  &foundValidProfile,
1420  frameTotalChirps,
1421  validChirpTxEnBits,
1422  bpmEnabled);
1423  if (retVal != 0)
1424  {
1425  goto exit;
1426  }
1427 
1428  /* found valid chirps for the frame; set remaining parameters */
1429  if (foundValidProfile == true) {
1430  rlProfileCfg_t profileCfg;
1431 
1432  outParams->validProfileIdx = profileLoopIdx;
1433  /* Get the profile configuration: */
1434  retVal = MMWave_getProfileCfg(profileHandle,&profileCfg, &errCode);
1435  if (retVal != 0)
1436  {
1437  retVal = errCode;
1438  goto exit;
1439  }
1440 
1441  #ifndef MMW_ENABLE_NEGATIVE_FREQ_SLOPE
1442  /* Check frequency slope */
1443  if (profileCfg.freqSlopeConst < 0)
1444  {
1445  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NEGATIVE_FREQ_SLOPE;
1446  goto exit;
1447  }
1448  #endif
1449  /* set other parameters */
1450  outParams->numAdcSamples = profileCfg.numAdcSamples;
1451 
1452  /* If input data is real, then only half the samples of the calcuated FFT (of
1453  order mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples)) will be valid due to
1454  symmetry. In that case, the number of effective range bins would be
1455  mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples); */
1456  if (outParams->adcDataFmtIsReal){
1457  outParams->numRangeBins = mathUtils_getValidFFTSize(outParams->numAdcSamples)/2;
1458  }
1459  else{
1460  outParams->numRangeBins = mathUtils_getValidFFTSize(outParams->numAdcSamples);
1461  }
1462 
1463  outParams->numChirpsPerFrame = frameTotalChirps * numLoops;
1464 
1465  outParams->numDopplerChirps = outParams->numChirpsPerFrame;
1466  outParams->numDopplerBins = mathUtils_getValidFFTSize(outParams->numDopplerChirps);
1467 
1468  adcStart = ((float)profileCfg.adcStartTimeConst * 10.f * 1.e-9);
1469  startFreq = (float)profileCfg.startFreqConst/(float)(1U << 26)*rfFreqScaleFactor*(float)1e9;
1470  slope = (float)profileCfg.freqSlopeConst * ((rfFreqScaleFactor*1e3*900.f)/(float)(1U << 26)) * 1e12;
1471  bandwidth = (slope * outParams->numAdcSamples)/(profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3);
1472  centerFreq = startFreq + bandwidth * 0.5f + adcStart * slope;
1473  outParams->chirpInterval = (float)(profileCfg.idleTimeConst + profileCfg.rampEndTime)/1000.*10*1.e-6;
1474 
1475  outParams->rangeStep = (MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC * profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3) /
1476  (2.f * slope * mathUtils_getValidFFTSize(outParams->numAdcSamples));
1477  outParams->rangeResolution = (MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC * profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3) /
1478  (2.f * slope * outParams->numAdcSamples);
1479 
1480  outParams->dopplerStep = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC /
1481  (2.f * outParams->numDopplerBins *
1482  centerFreq * outParams->chirpInterval);
1483  outParams->dopplerResolution = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC /
1484  (2.f * outParams->numChirpsPerFrame * centerFreq * outParams->chirpInterval);
1485 
1486  #ifdef MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_DBG
1487  printf("Ant setting virtualAzim: %d , virtual Elev :%d\n",
1488  outParams->numVirtualAntAzim, outParams->numVirtualAntElev);
1489  printf("startFreqConst: %d\n", profileCfg.startFreqConst);
1490  printf("rfFreqScaleFactor: %f\n", rfFreqScaleFactor);
1491  printf("bandwidth : %f GHz\n", bandwidth*1.e-9);
1492  printf("adcStartTimeConst: %d\n", profileCfg.adcStartTimeConst);
1493  printf("freqSlopeConst: %d\n", profileCfg.freqSlopeConst);
1494  printf("centerFreq: %f GHz\n", centerFreq*1.e-9);
1495  printf("dopplerStep: %f\n", outParams->dopplerStep);
1496  printf("adcStart: %f us\n", adcStart * 1e6);
1497  printf("slope: %f GHz\n", slope*1.e-9);
1498  printf("startFreq: %f GHz\n", startFreq*1.e-9);
1499  printf("numRangeBins: %d\n", outParams->numRangeBins);
1500  printf("rangeStep: %f\n", outParams->rangeStep);
1501  printf("rangeResolution: %f\n", outParams->rangeResolution);
1502  printf("numDopplerChirps: %d\n", outParams->numDopplerChirps);
1503  printf("numDopplerBins: %d\n", outParams->numDopplerBins);
1504  #endif
1505 
1506  }/* end of foundValidProfile condition */
1507  }/* end of profile loop */
1508 
1509  if (foundValidProfile == false)
1510  {
1511  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__VALID_PROFILECFG_NOT_FOUND;
1512  goto exit;
1513  }
1514  }/* end of dfeDataOutputMode if condition*/
1515 
1516  else if((ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_CHIRP_LEGACY_FRAME)||
1517  (ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_CHIRP_ADVANCED_FRAME))
1518  {
1519  /* In advance chirp mode, numLoops is the total number of chirps in a frame. */
1520  numLoops = MmwDemo_RFParser_getNumLoops(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
1521  outParams->framePeriod = MmwDemo_RFParser_getFramePeriod_ms(ctrlCfg, subFrameIdx);
1522 
1523  if (ctrlCfg->dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_CHIRP_ADVANCED_FRAME)
1524  {
1525  if(ctrlCfg->u.advancedFrameCfg[0].frameCfg.frameSeq.subFrameCfg[subFrameIdx].numOfBurst != 1)
1526  {
1527  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NON_ONE_NUMOFBURST_FOR_ADVANCED_FRAME;
1528  goto exit;
1529  }
1530  }
1531 
1532  uint8_t advChirpParamIdx =0;
1533  MMWave_AdvChirpHandle advChirpHandle;
1534  rlAdvChirpCfg_t advChirpCfg;
1535  rlUInt16_t patternIdx=0, lutResetPeriod=0;
1536  rlInt32_t* lutDataPtr;
1537  rlInt32_t lutData = 0;
1538  MMWave_ProfileHandle profileHandle;
1539  rlProfileCfg_t profileCfg;
1540  rlUInt16_t deltaResetPeriod=0;
1541  rlInt32_t deltaDither =0;
1542  float deltaDitherAvg=0, LUTDataAvg=0;
1543 
1544  for(advChirpParamIdx =0; advChirpParamIdx< MMWAVE_ADVANCE_CHIRP_NUM_PARAMS; advChirpParamIdx++)
1545  {
1546  /* Get the Advanced Chirp Handle associated at the specified param index */
1547  if(MMWave_getAdvChirpHandle((MMWave_Handle)gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle, advChirpParamIdx, &advChirpHandle, &errCode)<0)
1548  {
1549  /* Error: Unable to get the chirp handle */
1550  retVal = errCode;
1551  goto exit;
1552  }
1553 
1554  /* get the advance chirp configs */
1555  retVal = MMWave_getAdvChirpParams(advChirpHandle, &advChirpCfg, &errCode);
1556  if(retVal!=0)
1557  {
1558  retVal = errCode;
1559  goto exit;
1560  }
1561 
1562  /* get the LUT data ptr */
1563  retVal = MMWave_getLUTData(advChirpHandle, &lutDataPtr, &errCode);
1564  lutDataPtr = lutDataPtr + advChirpCfg.lutSfIndexOffset*subFrameIdx;
1565  if((retVal!=0)||(lutDataPtr==NULL))
1566  {
1567  retVal = errCode;
1568  goto exit;
1569  }
1570 
1571  if(advChirpCfg.deltaResetPeriod == 0)
1572  deltaResetPeriod = numLoops; /* reset as per global reset mode, i.e after burst/subframe/frame*/
1573  else if(advChirpCfg.deltaResetPeriod == 1)
1574  deltaResetPeriod = 0; /* delta increment is diabled */
1575  else
1576  deltaResetPeriod = advChirpCfg.deltaResetPeriod; /* reset after every deltaResetPeriod (M) chirps */
1577 
1578  /* similar to deltaResetPeriod; */
1579  if(advChirpCfg.lutResetPeriod == 0)
1580  lutResetPeriod = numLoops;
1581  else if(advChirpCfg.lutResetPeriod == 1)
1582  lutResetPeriod = 0;
1583  else
1584  lutResetPeriod = advChirpCfg.lutResetPeriod;
1585 
1586  switch(subFrameIdx)
1587  {
1588  case 0:
1589  {
1590  deltaDither = advChirpCfg.sf0ChirpParamDelta;
1591  break;
1592  }
1593  case 1:
1594  {
1595  deltaDither = advChirpCfg.sf1ChirpParamDelta;
1596  break;
1597  }
1598  case 2:
1599  {
1600  deltaDither = advChirpCfg.sf2ChirpParamDelta;
1601  break;
1602  }
1603  case 3:
1604  {
1605  deltaDither = advChirpCfg.sf3ChirpParamDelta;
1606  break;
1607  }
1608  default:
1609  {
1610  /* invalid subframe number*/
1611  retVal=-1;
1612  goto exit;
1613  }
1614  }
1615 
1616  switch(advChirpParamIdx)
1617  {
1618  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_PROFILE_VAR:
1619  {
1620  /* we support only one profile per subframe in this processing chain */
1621  /* get the configured profile: assuming the first configured profile is valid for all the chirps in a frame */
1622  lutData = *(lutDataPtr);
1623 
1624  /* check if the configured profile is defined or not */
1625  profileHandle = MmwDemo_RFParser_getProfileHandle(ctrlCfg, lutData);
1626  if (profileHandle == NULL)
1627  {
1628  foundValidProfile = false;
1629  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__VALID_PROFILECFG_NOT_FOUND; /*profile not defined*/
1630  goto exit;
1631  }
1632 
1633  retVal = MMWave_getProfileCfg(profileHandle, &profileCfg, &errCode);
1634  if (retVal != 0)
1635  {
1636  foundValidProfile = false;
1637  retVal = errCode;
1638  goto exit;
1639  }
1640  foundValidProfile = true;
1641  break;
1642  }
1643  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_FREQ_START_VAR:
1644  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_FREQ_SLOPE_VAR:
1645  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_IDLE_TIME_VAR:
1646  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_ADC_START_TIME_VAR:
1647  {
1648  /* average of dithers when delta dither is enabled*/
1649  deltaDitherAvg =0;
1650  /* delta dither is enabled when deltaParamUpdatePeriod!=0 and deltaResetPeriod!=0*/
1651  if(advChirpCfg.deltaParamUpdatePeriod !=0)
1652  {
1653  /* average of sum of Arithmetic Progression series */
1654  /* Sum = n/2[a0+a_n] = (n-1)/2[0+\delta*1+\delta*(n-1)] = (n-1)/2[\delta*n] */
1655  /* Avg = \delta * (n-1) /2 ; n= #numUpdates*/
1656  /* Assuming deltaResetPeriod is integer multiple of deltaParamUpdatePeriod; as it should be*/
1657  deltaDitherAvg = (float)(deltaDither * (float)(deltaResetPeriod/advChirpCfg.deltaParamUpdatePeriod -1)) /2.f;
1658  }
1659 
1660  /* average of lut dithers when lut dither is enabled */
1661  if ((advChirpCfg.lutParamUpdatePeriod !=0) && (lutResetPeriod!=0))
1662  {
1663  for (patternIdx =0; patternIdx< lutResetPeriod/advChirpCfg.lutParamUpdatePeriod; patternIdx++)
1664  {
1665  LUTDataAvg += *(lutDataPtr + patternIdx);
1666  }
1667  LUTDataAvg = (float)LUTDataAvg/patternIdx;
1668  }
1669  else
1670  {
1671  /* first lut value is used */
1672  LUTDataAvg = *lutDataPtr;
1673  }
1674 
1675  switch(advChirpParamIdx)
1676  {
1677  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_FREQ_START_VAR:
1678  {
1679  /* Average start frequency for a frame */
1680  startFreq = (float)profileCfg.startFreqConst/(float)(1U << 26)*rfFreqScaleFactor*(float)1e9 +
1681  (float)deltaDitherAvg/(float)(1U << 26)*rfFreqScaleFactor*(float)1e9 +
1682  (float)LUTDataAvg/(float)(1U << 26)*rfFreqScaleFactor*(float)1e9*(float)(1U<<advChirpCfg.lutChirpParamScale);
1683  break;
1684  }
1685  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_FREQ_SLOPE_VAR:
1686  {
1687  /* Average frequency slope for a frame */
1688  slope = (float)profileCfg.freqSlopeConst*((rfFreqScaleFactor*1e3*900.f)/(float)(1U << 26)) * 1e12 +
1689  (float)deltaDitherAvg*((rfFreqScaleFactor*1e3*900.f)/(float)(1U << 26)) * 1e12 +
1690  (float)LUTDataAvg*((rfFreqScaleFactor*1e3*900.f)/(float)(1U << 26)) * 1e12;
1691  break;
1692  }
1693  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_IDLE_TIME_VAR:
1694  {
1695  /* Average idle time for a frame */
1696  idleTime = (float)profileCfg.idleTimeConst*10*1.e-9 +
1697  (float)deltaDitherAvg*10*1.e-9 +
1698  (float)LUTDataAvg*10*1.e-9*(1U << advChirpCfg.lutChirpParamScale);
1699  break;
1700  }
1701  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_ADC_START_TIME_VAR:
1702  {
1703  /* Average adc start time for a frame */
1704  adcStart = (float)profileCfg.adcStartTimeConst*10*1.e-9 +
1705  (float)deltaDitherAvg*10*1.e-9 +
1706  (float)LUTDataAvg*10*1.e-9*(1U << advChirpCfg.lutChirpParamScale);
1707  break;
1708  }
1709  }
1710  break;
1711  }
1712  case RL_LUT_CHIRP_TX_EN_VAR:
1713  {
1714  int32_t chirpTxEn;
1715  uint16_t validChirpTxEnBits[MMWAVE_EACH_CHIRP_PARAM_MAX_LUT_BUF_SIZE]={0};
1716  /* check for all the chirps in a frame/subframe, if valid TX antenna is enabled */
1717  if ((advChirpCfg.lutParamUpdatePeriod != 0 ) && (lutResetPeriod!=0))
1718  {
1719  /* more than 1 pattern of TX antenna is configured in LUT: traverse and check if valid TX antennas is enabled*/
1720  for (patternIdx =0; patternIdx< lutResetPeriod/advChirpCfg.lutParamUpdatePeriod; patternIdx++)
1721  {
1722  chirpTxEn = *(lutDataPtr+patternIdx);
1723  if((chirpTxEn != 0)&&((chirpTxEn & channelTxEn) > 0))
1724  {
1725  validChirpTxEnBits[patternIdx] = (uint16_t)chirpTxEn;
1726  }
1727  else
1728  {
1729  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__INVALID_TX_ANTENNA_ENABLED;
1730  goto exit;
1731  }
1732  }
1733  }
1734  else
1735  {
1736  /* first lut value is used */
1737  chirpTxEn = *(lutDataPtr);
1738  validChirpTxEnBits[0] = (uint16_t)chirpTxEn;
1739  patternIdx =1;
1740  }
1741  /* now parse through all valid chirps, check if the profile is valid and then set the AoA related parameters */
1742  retVal = MmwDemo_RFParser_setAoAParamsDDM(outParams,
1743  &foundValidProfile,
1744  patternIdx,
1745  validChirpTxEnBits,
1746  bpmEnabled);
1747  break;
1748  }
1749  }/* end of switch case */
1750  }/* end of advance chirp params for loop */
1751 
1752  /* found valid chirps for the frame; set remaining parameters */
1753  if (foundValidProfile == true)
1754  {
1755 #ifndef MMW_ENABLE_NEGATIVE_FREQ_SLOPE
1756  /* Check frequency slope */
1757  if (profileCfg.freqSlopeConst < 0)
1758  {
1759  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NEGATIVE_FREQ_SLOPE;
1760  goto exit;
1761  }
1762 #endif
1763  /* set other parameters */
1764  outParams->numAdcSamples = profileCfg.numAdcSamples;
1765 
1766  /* If input data is real, then only half the samples of the calcuated FFT (of
1767  order mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples)) will be valid due to
1768  symmetry. In that case, the number of effective range bins would be
1769  mathUtils_pow2roundup(outParams->numAdcSamples); */
1770  if (outParams->adcDataFmtIsReal){
1771  outParams->numRangeBins = mathUtils_getValidFFTSize(outParams->numAdcSamples)/2;
1772  }
1773  else{
1774  outParams->numRangeBins = mathUtils_getValidFFTSize(outParams->numAdcSamples);
1775  }
1776 
1777  outParams->numChirpsPerFrame = numLoops;
1778 
1779  outParams->numDopplerChirps = outParams->numChirpsPerFrame;
1780  outParams->numDopplerBins = mathUtils_getValidFFTSize(outParams->numDopplerChirps);
1781 
1782  bandwidth = (slope * outParams->numAdcSamples)/(profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3);
1783  centerFreq = startFreq + bandwidth * 0.5f + adcStart * slope;
1784  outParams->chirpInterval = (float)idleTime + (float)((float)profileCfg.rampEndTime/1000.*10*1.e-6);
1785 
1786  outParams->rangeStep = (MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC * profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3) /
1787  (2.f * slope * mathUtils_getValidFFTSize(outParams->numAdcSamples));
1788  outParams->rangeResolution = (MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC * profileCfg.digOutSampleRate * 1e3) /
1789  (2.f * slope * outParams->numAdcSamples);
1790 
1791  outParams->dopplerStep = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC /
1792  (2.f * outParams->numDopplerBins *
1793  centerFreq * outParams->chirpInterval);
1794  outParams->dopplerResolution = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_IN_METERS_PER_SEC /
1795  (2.f * outParams->numChirpsPerFrame * centerFreq * outParams->chirpInterval);
1796 
1797 #ifdef MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_DBG
1798  printf("Ant setting virtualAzim: %d , virtual Elev :%d\n",
1799  outParams->numVirtualAntAzim, outParams->numVirtualAntElev);
1800  printf("startFreqConst: %d\n", profileCfg.startFreqConst);
1801  printf("rfFreqScaleFactor: %f\n", rfFreqScaleFactor);
1802  printf("bandwidth : %f GHz\n", bandwidth*1.e-9);
1803  printf("adcStartTimeConst: %d\n", profileCfg.adcStartTimeConst);
1804  printf("freqSlopeConst: %d\n", profileCfg.freqSlopeConst);
1805  printf("centerFreq: %f GHz\n", centerFreq*1.e-9);
1806  printf("dopplerStep: %f\n", outParams->dopplerStep);
1807  printf("adcStart: %f us\n", adcStart * 1e6);
1808  printf("idleTime: %f us\n", idleTime * 1e6);
1809  printf("slope: %f GHz\n", slope*1.e-9);
1810  printf("startFreq: %f GHz\n", startFreq*1.e-9);
1811  printf("numRangeBins: %d\n", outParams->numRangeBins);
1812  printf("rangeStep: %f\n", outParams->rangeStep);
1813  printf("rangeResolution: %f\n", outParams->rangeResolution);
1814  printf("numDopplerChirps: %d\n", outParams->numDopplerChirps);
1815  printf("numDopplerBins: %d\n", outParams->numDopplerBins);
1816 #endif
1817 
1818  }/* end of foundValidProfile condition */
1819 
1820  else
1821  {
1822  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__VALID_PROFILECFG_NOT_FOUND;
1823  goto exit;
1824  }
1825 
1826  }/* end of dfeDataOutputMode else condition*/
1827 exit:
1828  return (retVal);
1829 }

1845 static int32_t MmwDemo_RFParser_parseADCBufCfg
1846 (
1847  MmwDemo_RFParserOutParams *outParams,
1848  MmwDemo_ADCBufCfg *adcBufCfg
1849 )
1850 {
1851  uint16_t numBytePerSample = 0;
1852  uint32_t chirpThreshold;
1853  uint32_t maxChirpThreshold;
1854  uint32_t bytesPerChirp;
1855  int32_t retVal = 0;
1856 
1857 #if defined(SOC_AWR294X)|| defined(SOC_AWR2X44P)
1858  /* Only support Real */
1859  if (adcBufCfg->adcFmt != 1)
1860  {
1861  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__ADC_FORMAT;
1862  goto exit;
1863  }
1864 #else
1865  /* Support Real or Complex */
1866  if (adcBufCfg->adcFmt != 0 && adcBufCfg->adcFmt != 1)
1867  {
1868  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__ADC_FORMAT;
1869  goto exit;
1870  }
1871 #endif
1872 
1873  if (adcBufCfg->adcFmt == 1){
1874  numBytePerSample = 2U; /* Real Data */
1875  }
1876  else if (adcBufCfg->adcFmt == 0){
1877  numBytePerSample = 4U; /* Complex Data */
1878  }
1879 
1880  /* Calculate RX channel data size and make it align to 16 bytes */
1881  outParams->adcBufChanDataSize = outParams->numAdcSamples * numBytePerSample;
1882  outParams->adcBufChanDataSize = (outParams->adcBufChanDataSize + 15U) / 16U * 16U;
1883 
1884  /* Calculate max possible chirp threshold */
1885  bytesPerChirp = outParams->adcBufChanDataSize * outParams->numRxAntennas;
1886 
1887  /* find maximum number of full chirps that can fit in the ADCBUF memory, while
1888  also being able to divide numChirpsPerFrame, we do not want remainder processing */
1889  maxChirpThreshold = MmwDemo_RFParserHwCfg.adcBufSize/ bytesPerChirp;
1890  if (maxChirpThreshold >= outParams->numChirpsPerFrame)
1891  {
1892  maxChirpThreshold = outParams->numChirpsPerFrame;
1893  if (maxChirpThreshold > SYS_COMMON_CQ_MAX_CHIRP_THRESHOLD)
1894  {
1895  /* If CQ monitor is enabled, then check max chirpthreshold */
1896  maxChirpThreshold = SYS_COMMON_CQ_MAX_CHIRP_THRESHOLD;
1897  }
1898  }
1899  else
1900  {
1901  /* Find largest divisor of numChirpsPerFrame no bigger than maxChirpThreshold */
1902  while (outParams->numChirpsPerFrame % maxChirpThreshold)
1903  {
1904  maxChirpThreshold--;
1905  }
1906  }
1907 
1908  /* ADCBuf control function requires argument alignment at 4 bytes boundary */
1909  chirpThreshold = adcBufCfg->chirpThreshold;
1910 
1911  /* if automatic, set to the calculated max */
1912  if (chirpThreshold == 0)
1913  {
1914  chirpThreshold = maxChirpThreshold;
1915  }
1916  else
1917  {
1918  if (chirpThreshold > maxChirpThreshold)
1919  {
1920 #ifdef MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_DBG
1921  printf("Desired chirpThreshold %d higher than max possible of %d, setting to max\n",
1922  chirpThreshold, maxChirpThreshold);
1923 #endif
1924  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__CHIRP_THRESH_GREATER_THAN_MAX_ALLOWED;
1925  goto exit;
1926  }
1927  else
1928  {
1929  /* check for divisibility of the user provided threshold */
1930  if((outParams->numChirpsPerFrame % chirpThreshold) != 0)
1931  {
1932  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_ENOTSUPPORT__NON_DIVISIBILITY_OF_CHIRP_THRESH;
1933  goto exit;
1934  }
1935  else
1936  {
1937  /* Chirp threshold has a valid configuration */
1938  }
1939  }
1940  }
1941 
1942 #ifdef MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_DBG
1943  printf(" chirpThreshold %d max = %d, \n",
1944  chirpThreshold, maxChirpThreshold);
1945 #endif
1946 
1947  /* Save chirpThreshold */
1948  outParams->numChirpsPerChirpEvent = chirpThreshold;
1949 
1950 exit:
1951  return (retVal);
1952 }

2015  subFrameIdx,
2016  openCfg, ctrlCfg,
2017  rfFreqScaleFactor,
2018  bpmEnable);
2019  }
2020  if (retVal != 0)
2021  {
2022  goto exit;
2023  }
2024 
2025  retVal = MmwDemo_RFParser_parseADCBufCfg(outParams, adcBufCfg);
2026  if (retVal != 0)
2027  {
2028  goto exit;
2029  }
2030  }
2031  else
2032  {
2033  retVal = MMWDEMO_RFPARSER_EINVAL__NUM_SUBFRAMES;
2034  }
2035 
2036 exit:
2037  return retVal;
2038 }
